summary: The generated endpoint commands messages list, messages show, accounts and folders, and the generated sync command, run local implementations: their RunE bodies call the hand-owned tb_*.go helpers (store queries, mbox reads, prefs.js fallback), sync runs runTBSync over the Thunderbird profile, and defaultSyncResources/knownSyncResourceNames return tbResourceTypes, and the human output of search, accounts and folders is written through tbHumanOut (a tbSafeWriter sink) so mail-borne C0/C1 control characters (which encoding/json leaves raw for C1) never reach the terminal. Shared helpers (tbAccountRow, tbAccountMatches, tbMessageDetail, tbBuildDetail, tbPrintDetail, tbStoredAttachments) live in hand-owned files, so only the command bodies differ from the print.
reason: The spec is local-sqlite with no HTTP API: the generator emits these commands against an HTTP client and a paginated API sync that cannot reach a Thunderbird profile on disk, so a fresh print would bring back commands that fail with a network error instead of reading the local store.
call_sites: return runTBSyncCommand(cmd, flags, resources, full, dbPath)
validated_outcome: tb_slice_b_test.go and tb_commands_test.go run messages list/show, accounts and folders against the tbtest fixture store; tb_sync_test.go and tb_sync_r1_test.go cover sync; TestTBSyncAnnotatedLocalWrite checks the sync annotation; TestTBHumanOutputSanitized and TestTBHumanOutputSanitizedAtSink check the human sink.
